description: This Java class 'SaxParserFactory' provides a factory method to create configured SAXParser instances and includes a main method demonstrating its usage to parse an XML file.

classes.name: SaxParserFactory
classes.description: Utility class providing a static method to create a configured SAXParser instance and a main method for testing parsing an XML file.

methods.name: getSaxParser
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SAXParser configured with specific features: namespace awareness disabled, validation enabled, and XInclude disabled.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Demonstrates the use of getSaxParser() to parse an XML file ('/ecu_defs.xml') and outputs the validation status.
